name: AmbiguityBench
description: AmbiguityBench is a curated dataset designed to evaluate the disentangled safety mechanisms in large language models, specifically testing the separation between harmfulness recognition and refusal execution.
reputation: A newer safety benchmark that has seen limited but growing interest for probing refusal behavior and harmfulness recognition separately.
notes: Focuses on causal double dissociation of safety mechanisms and enables evaluation of 'Knowing without Acting' states in LLMs.
